lead: The Business Model Canvas is a one-page map of how a business works, split into nine blocks. AI changed what four of them cost to run: Key Activities, Key Partners, Customer Relationships and Channels.
summary: This video reads the Business Model Canvas through an industrial-engineering systems lens, with examples from Base44, Duolingo, Klarna and Shopify of how AI has changed what four of its blocks cost to run. It then shows how to stress test your own business model by finding the one block that fails first, your leverage point, and what to try on it in fifteen minutes.
